description: Teardown plugin: decommissions the HCP Terraform no-code deployment backing the resource. Fails fast if a live CloudBolt job still owns the resource (resource-level attribution -- the auto-queued run's message is TFC-authored), else discards orphaned non-final runs, creates an auto-confirmed destroy run, then deletes the workspace via the safe-delete endpoint only -- never force-delete. Idempotent: no resource, no workspace (by stored ID or by cb-nc-<global_id> name), or an already-deleted workspace returns WARNING, not FAILURE.
name: Teardown HCP Terraform No-Code Module
